# Mark Labey

Mark Labey is the current Connétable of [Grouville](https://flow.je/elections/grouville) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Mark Labey has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mark-labey#e49)

  Elected as Connétable of Grouville with 51.5% of the vote.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/mark-labey/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N8uOixTwV8Y)
  - [2022 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20220820124836/https://www.marklabey.com/our-mission)

Mark Labey has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Connétables Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [Grouville](https://flow.je/elections/grouville). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/07/constable-aiming-to-go-again-in-grouville/)\]

Links for Mark Labey:

- Twitter : [@mark\_labey](https://twitter.com/mark_labey)

## Election History

### 2022 Connétables Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [Grouville](https://flow.je/elections/grouville) (1 seat), 22nd June 2022.

**Mark Labey was elected as Connétable of Grouville in 2022**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Mark Labey** |  | 975 | 51.5% |
| 2 | [Sarah Howard](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sarah-howard) |  | 903 | 47.7% |

1,895 votes (inc. 17 spoilt papers)

3,726 registered voters

= 50.9% turnout
